architecture.mechanism: Enhanced cathodic polarization to -0.95 V (vs. CSE) to inhibit microbial adhesion, promote calcareous deposit formation, and mitigate localized corrosion at coating defects.
architecture.intervention: Deploy auxiliary anodes at the far ends of the pipeline section to locally boost cathodic polarization to **-0.95 V** (vs. CSE) without increasing total rectifier power, using distributed low-current outputs or smart anode arrays.
architecture.expected_effect: Reduced current drain from coating holidays, suppression of SRB biofilm activity, and formation of protective calcareous deposits that restore and stabilize pipe-to-soil potential toward **-0.85 V** or better.
architecture.falsification_test: Install temporary reference electrodes at 50-ft intervals along the pipeline ends, measure pipe-to-soil potential after 14 days of auxiliary anode activation, and verify ≥90% of readings meet **-0.85 V** while confirming no cathodic disbondment via ultrasonic coating inspection.
